title: He didn’t give them a map.
paragraphs:
He didn’t give them a map.
He gave them a Presence.

Exodus 13:21 says:
“By day the LORD went ahead of them in a pillar of cloud to guide them on their way and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light, so that they could travel by day or night.”
Pause.

They just left slavery.
No GPS. No blueprint. No guarantees.
Just… God in front.

A cloud in the heat.
A fire in the dark.

Guidance that moved.
Presence that stayed.
But here’s what we miss…
The same God who led them visibly now leads us personally—through Jesus Christ.

You may not see a pillar in the sky.
But the cross stands as proof:
God still goes before you.

When you’re confused—He leads.
When you’re afraid—He lights the way.
When you feel stuck—He moves, and calls you to follow.
And yes… sometimes the path looks like a detour.
But it’s not.
It’s deliverance in disguise.

Because the same God who led Israel out of Egypt
is the same Savior who leads you out of sin.
Through Jesus, you’re not wandering.
You’re being led.

So don’t rush ahead.
Don’t lag behind.
Stay close to the Presence.

Today, if you feel lost—fix your eyes on Christ.
He doesn’t just show the way.
He is the Way.
From confusion to clarity—because Jesus still leads.
